whyItMatters: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a go.work `use` directive that reaches outside the workspace root.
actions: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix a go.work `use` directive that reaches outside the workspace root.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm go.work no longer carries a go.work `use` directive that reaches outside the workspace root.
